marks.gloss_en: דתנן: רבי יהושע אומר, האוכל אוכל ראשון ואוכל שני -- שני (Steinsaltz: and a sheni disqualifies teruma without rendering it impure)
Rabba bar bar Chana: the tanna for whom eating first- or second-degree food disqualifies [teruma] but does not render it impure is R' Yehoshua
משום דרבי פרנך, דאמר רבי פרנך אמר רבי יוחנן: האוחז ספר תורה ערום נקבר ערום
בלא מצות סלקא דעתך? -- could he really be buried without [any] mitzvot? (replaced by: without that mitzva)
the hands [were decreed impure] because hands are busy
אמר ליה רבא: מאי נפקא מינה, הא קא טבלי בהנך? -- what difference does it make? they are immersing in those [the cave water] anyway
Abaye: keva means they would say: not these [the cave water] purify, but these and those together purify
the Sages decreed impurity on one who eats impure food because at times he eats impure food, takes teruma liquids, casts them into his mouth and disqualifies them
the Sages decreed impurity on one who drinks impure liquids because at times he drinks them, takes teruma food, casts it into his mouth and disqualifies it
Rav Asi: at first they immersed in collected, foul cave water and poured drawn water on themselves; they began to make it keva, so [the Sages] decreed impurity on them
the decree on a pure person on whom three log of drawn water fell: if not for this, that [decree] would not stand
Rav Mesharshiya: at first they stored teruma food beside the Torah scroll, saying 'this is holy and that is holy'; when they saw it came to ruin, the Sages decreed impurity on it
(entertained) the decree on hands in general was issued first
